description: A folder owned by one team that implements one business capability and exposes a small public API through its `index` file.
The single place that knows which modules exist and wires them into the shell (`createApp()`).
`register(shell)`: a module adds its routes, navigation entries and subscriptions to extension points offered by the shell.
A publish/subscribe channel (`emit`, `on`) that lets modules react to each other's facts without importing each other.
A file mapping paths to teams so changes in a module require that team's review.
An automated check (lint rule, dependency-cruiser, Nx tags or a custom test) that fails the build when an import crosses a forbidden boundary.
